# Outputs

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_outputs.py from outputs.yaml: do not edit by hand. -->

## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| plant-readiness-brief | `assets/plant-readiness-brief.md`, filled before either route | Plant ME, Plant IT | Plant row, flags and plant-only questions are filled from the Machine List and Tool Overview |
| assessment-protocol-route-a | `assets/assessment-protocol.md`, one per plant or wave | Plant ME, Plant IT, then Mode B per machine | Inventory and roadmap agreed; Each machine in scope carries concept, connector and sequence position; Barriers logged; Investment planned; Cyber Security gate identified |
| guidance-protocol-route-b | `assets/guidance-protocol.md`, one per machine | `mi-signals`, `deploy-acceptance`, `mi-flow` | Gates 0 to 4 recorded in order; Concept, connector, sequence position, logged barriers and Cyber Security status stated |
| records-updated | Machine List, Machine CV and Edge Device List | MPEE OD (informed) | All three updated; `INTEGRATED` set only after `deploy-acceptance` passes |
| investment-for-approval | Sized investment from Mode A step 6 | `dept-decision-rights` | Investment sized and taken through integration investment planning |

## Checks

| Output | Check | Sign-off |
|---|---|---|
| plant-readiness-brief | structure of `assets/plant-readiness-brief.md` | Plant ME |
| assessment-protocol-route-a | structure of `assets/assessment-protocol.md` | Plant ME |
| guidance-protocol-route-b | structure of `assets/guidance-protocol.md` | OD lead |

| investment-for-approval | manual | OD lead |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `funnel-evaluation`, `catalog-systems`, `dept-context`, `mi-data-availability`, `dept-decision-rights`
- **Next:** mi-signals (tag list, PLC program version, Machine CV), mi-flow (pipeline, step 3b4) and deploy-acceptance (step 3b6).: `mi-signals`, `mi-flow`, `deploy-acceptance`
- **Stops here when:** no route exists (log the barrier and escalate into the roadmap, never omit the machine silently), a guide branch is TODO (say which, take the other platform's route if written, else escalate to the IIAE), or Cyber Security sign-off is…
- **Stops here when:** Only a human connects a machine
- **Stops here when:** never mark INTEGRATED before acceptance passes
